## What's new

- New look: a champagne gold app icon, a sidebar window with frosted macOS glass, settings grouped into cards, and gold switches. Works in light and dark mode.
- A much smaller dictation pill: a slim dark bead with gold bars, no red dot.
- Smooth motion throughout: pages, switches, buttons, lists and the pill all animate. Reduce Motion in System Settings turns it into simple fades.
- Mac: updates keep Shabdly's Accessibility and microphone permissions (since 0.1.4).

## Download

| Your computer | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) | `Shabdly_..._aarch64.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or 11 | `Shabdly_..._x64-setup.exe` |

These builds are not signed with a paid certificate yet, so your computer will warn you the first time. The README explains the one-time steps: [Install](https://github.com/Karthik-Kumar02/shabdly#install).

For private, free cleanup, also install [Ollama](https://ollama.com/download). Shabdly's setup checks for it and downloads its model for you.
